standard_prerequisites.name: The hypotheses of the statement: openness of the map, sobriety of the source, finiteness of the fibres of the two maps, lifting of generalizations along them, and the quotient description of the target
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: The five numbered items of the counted statement itself (source lines 3936-3943)
standard_prerequisites.use: Each hypothesis is used in the proof: finiteness makes equivalence classes finite, lifting of generalizations transfers specializations, and openness relates the topology of the quotient to that of the source.

core_obligations: Finite equivalence classes: hypotheses (3) and (5) imply that a point of X corresponds to a finite equivalence class in U, which the proof writes as a finite set of representatives (proof lines 3948-3951).

Transfer of specializations: if one representative specializes to a representative of a second class, the lifting property (4) supplies a lift of that specialization in R, and applying t gives the corresponding specialization between the representatives (proof lines 3952-3956).

The separation argument: the proof uses the openness of the map and sobriety of U to produce an open set that separates the two classes whenever the specialization relation holds in only one direction (proof lines 3956-3976).

Conclusion: if two points satisfy the specialization relation both ways their classes coincide, so distinct points are separated by an open set, which is precisely the Kolmogorov property (proof lines 3977-3978).
proof_roadmap: 先由有限纤维与商描述把 X 的点对应到 U 中的有限等价类。
再用 generalizations lift along s,t 把类之间的 specialization 提升到 R 上，借 U 的 sober 性与 π 的开性构造开集把两类分开；若双向 specialize 则两类相同，于是 X 是 Kolmogorov。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the Kolmogorov property of a quotient of a sober space by a finite-fibre equivalence relation along which generalizations lift, with the quotient map open (author lemma at source lines 3932-3945, label lemma-quotient-kolmogorov). The proof (source lines 3947-3979) uses all five hypotheses in a chain: finiteness of fibres turns points of the quotient into finite equivalence classes, the lifting property transfers specializations between representatives, and the openness of the map together with sobriety of the source is what supplies the open set that separates two points whose classes differ. The statement is one of the technical steps by which the author controls quotients of sober spaces in this chapter. H2.
